creatorPage.aboutText: Welcome to an exclusive winter journey through Spiti Valley, inspired by Ananya Sharma's unforgettable Himalayan adventure. After capturing the hearts of travelers with her winter escape to Kashmir, Ananya set her sights on something even more raw, remote, and transformative — Spiti in winter. Braving frozen roads, sub-zero temperatures, and untouched trails, she experienced a side of the Himalayas few dare to explore.

aboutUs.title: About India Tourism Live Travels
aboutUs.subtitle: Crafting unforgettable adventures across India & beyond since 2018
aboutUs.story: India Tourism Live Travels was founded with a single mission: to make authentic, immersive, and transformative travel accessible to every explorer. From the snowbound valleys of Spiti and the frozen wonders of Kashmir, to the pristine rainforests of Meghalaya and the tropical waters of Bali and Vietnam, we curate end-to-end expeditions led by certified ground experts.
aboutUs.mission: We believe travel should be more than sightseeing. It should create lifelong bonds, support local mountain communities, and offer stress-free journeys backed by transparent pricing and 24x7 safety protocols.

termsAndConditions.title: Terms & Conditions
termsAndConditions.content:
1. Booking & Permits: A valid Government ID (Aadhaar / Passport) is mandatory for permits and hotel check-ins.
2. Itinerary Alterations: Mountain expeditions are subject to weather conditions, snowfall, and BRO road clearance. The tour leader reserves the right to alter schedules for group safety.
3. Traveler Code of Conduct: Participants are expected to maintain respect towards local mountain communities and fellow travelers.
4. Liability: India Tour is not responsible for personal belongings or flight delays caused by external weather factors.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.content:
1. Information Collection: We collect only the information necessary to fulfill your bookings, process government inner-line permits, and provide 24x7 customer support.
2. Data Security: Your personal data, payment details, and contact numbers are encrypted and never sold to third-party advertisers.
3. Communications: We only send itinerary updates, booking confirmations, and important departure advisories via WhatsApp and Email.
4. Traveler Rights: You may request deletion or updates to your traveler profile at any time by contacting our support team.

cancellationPolicy.title: Cancellation & Refund Policy
cancellationPolicy.content:
1. 30+ Days Prior to Departure: 90% cash refund or 100% lifetime travel credit voucher.
2. 15 to 29 Days Prior to Departure: 50% refund.
3. Less than 15 Days: Non-refundable due to advance hotel lock-ins and vehicle reservations.
4. Force Majeure: In the event of trip cancellation by organizers due to extreme weather, road closures, or natural calamities, a 100% lifetime credit shell is issued.
5. No Cost EMI: EMI refunds are processed back to the original funding account within 5-7 banking days.
